problem.title: Prime Number
problem.statement: Given a number n, determine whether it is a prime number or not.Note: A prime number is a number greater than 1 that has no positive divisors other than 1 and itself.

examples.explanation: 7 has exactly two divisors: 1 and 7, making it a prime number.
25 has more than two divisors: 1, 5, and 25, so it is not a prime number.
1 has only one divisor (1 itself), which is not sufficient for it to be considered prime.
